2M likes, 17K comments - shawnmendes on September 24, 2026: "Oh man what a feeling to go through all these videos and photos😭
I guess what I feel is that in 10 years your life can really change in ways you never imagined for yourself, but ultimately those parts of us that make art and play and laugh come from the same pure place no matter how much time has passed… guys thank you. This album changed my life forever and I’ll never ever get tired of saying this.. I am so grateful for your love and friendship over the years. Here’s to 10 years of illuminate and here’s to 10 more ♥️🪽

Illuminate (10th Anniversary Edition) is out now".
